title: Add FAQ Section
content: Build FAQ accordion component. Container with max-w-3xl mx-auto for readability. Item structure: question as trigger button (w-full text-left flex justify-between), ChevronDown icon that rotates on open, answer panel with smooth height animation. Group related questions with section headers. Add search/filter functionality for many FAQs. Implement single-open (close others when opening) or multi-open behavior. Style: border-b between items, hover highlight on question, open state with background change. Accessibility: proper button semantics, aria-expanded, aria-controls on trigger, proper focus styles. Add "Was this helpful?" feedback option. Link to contact support for unanswered questions. Schema markup for SEO.

variants.simple: Build an FAQ accordion with expandable questions and answers.
variants.detailed: Build FAQ accordion component. Container with max-w-3xl mx-auto for readability. Item structure: question as trigger button (w-full text-left flex justify-between), ChevronDown icon that rotates on open, answer panel with smooth height animation. Group related questions with section headers. Add search/filter functionality for many FAQs. Implement single-open (close others when opening) or multi-open behavior. variants.advanced: Build FAQ accordion component with search, categories, and full accessibility. Container: max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-16. Section header: text-center "Frequently Asked Questions" h2, optional subtitle. Search bar: mb-8, relative with Search icon, filters FAQ items as user types, highlight matching text. Categories: if many FAQs, group by category with tabs or section headers. Accordion implementation: each item in array mapped to AccordionItem component. Item structure: div with border-b border-gray-200, last:border-0. Trigger button: w-full flex items-center justify-between py-5 text-left, question text (font-medium text-gray-900), ChevronDown icon with transform rotate-180 transition when open. Answer panel: using CSS grid technique (grid-rows-[0fr] to grid-rows-[1fr]) or max-height for smooth height animation, inner div with overflow-hidden and pb-5 for spacing. Answer content: prose styling, can include links, lists, formatted text. Behavior modes: prop for single-open (only one can be open) vs multi-open (independent). State: array of open indices or single index. Styling: question hover:text-blue-600, open item with subtle bg-gray-50. "Was this helpful?" feedback: Yes/No buttons at end of each answer, track responses. Contact CTA: "Can't find what you're looking for?" with link to contact/support at end of section. Schema markup: add FAQPage structured data for SEO (JSON-LD script). Animated icons: optional plus/minus icon morph instead of chevron rotation. ACCESSIBILITY: button role implicit, aria-expanded={isOpen}, aria-controls={panelId}, panel with id and role="region", keyboard navigation with Enter/Space to toggle. Mobile: ensure adequate tap targets (min 44px). Pre-expanded: option to expand specific items by default or via URL hash.
